summary: @servicetitan/uikit-docs preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a documentation package (package.json declares files: ["docs"]) but ships two additional root-level files, setup.mjs and math_init.js (727KB), not covered by the declared files allowlist. The package.json preinstall script runs `node setup.mjs`, which is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation and hex-named identifiers. setup.mjs detects the host platform/arch, constructs a URL of the form https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, downloads and extracts the Bun runtime binary to a temp directory, chmods it 0755, and invokes it against math_init.js. math_init.js is a `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle using the same string-array rotation obfuscation and is not readable without executing under the freshly downloaded Bun runtime. Fetching an alternate language runtime at install and using it to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle bypasses Node-based inspection and has no connection to the package's stated documentation purpose. The gap between the declared file manifest and the actually-published tarball is consistent with a compromised publish token or hijacked maintainer account.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
